name: modex-monorepo
description: Modex — an open, Codex-App-style desktop app that runs Claude Code and Codex through their CLIs.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @modex/core build && pnpm --filter @modex/desktop build && pnpm --filter @modex/site build && pnpm --filter @modex/store-desktop build
scripts.test: pnpm run test:worktrees && pnpm --filter @modex/core test && pnpm --filter @modex/desktop test && pnpm --filter @modex/site test && pnpm --filter @modex/store-desktop test
